name: Replicate
tagline: Replicate is a platform for running open-source AI models (image generators, LLMs, audio tools, video models) via a simple API without managing any infrastructure. Developers deploy their own models or call thousands of community-published models with a few lines of code and pay per second of compute. It's the fastest way to add any open-source AI capability to an application without standing up a GPU server.
